question: Who among the following female wrestlers won the Ukraine Wrestling Tournament in February 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vinesh Phogat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vinesh Phogat** won the Ukraine Wrestling Tournament in February 2021.
 
• Vinesh Phogat is an Indian wrestler who comes from a successful family of wrestlers, with her cousins Geeta Phogat and Babita Kumari, being international wrestlers and Commonwealth Games medalists as well.
 
• She became the first Indian woman wrestler to win Gold in both Commonwealth and Asian games.
 
• She has been honoured with the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in 2020.
 
• She is also conferred with the Arjuna Award.
